description: This file contains the implementation of a RecyclerView adapter called CalendarDayAdapter for displaying calendar days within a grid layout in an Android application. It manages rendering individual day views, handles their appearance based on whether the day belongs to the current month, indicates events, and handles click events on each day.

classes.name: CalendarDayAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying calendar days, managing day data, visual styling, and click events.

classes.name: CalendarDayAdapter.DayViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for the calendar day item view, holding references to its UI components.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for individual calendar day items and creates a new ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds calendar day data to the ViewHolder, setting text, appearance, and click behavior.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of days to display.

methods.name: updateDays
methods.description: Updates the list of days and refreshes the display.
